meta.name: dask
meta.description: Distributed computing for larger-than-RAM pandas/NumPy workflows. Use when you need to scale existing pandas/NumPy code beyond memory or across clusters. Best for parallel file processing, distributed ML, integration with existing pandas code. For out-of-core analytics on single machine use vaex; for in-memory speed use polars.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在集群上扩展 pandas 与 NumPy 的数据处理能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 pandas 代码因数据过大而内存溢出
copy.tagline_en: Scale your pandas and NumPy workflows across clusters
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pandas code runs out of memory with large datasets

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Dask 的 DataFrame、Array、Bag 等接口处理超出内存的数据,把任务拆分到多核或多机并行执行。
howto.when: 当你需要处理超出内存的数据、扩展 pandas/NumPy 代码,或并行读取多个文件/训练分布式模型时触发。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to process data larger than RAM by chunking and parallelizing pandas/NumPy-style operations, using Dask DataFrames, Arrays, Bags, and distributed schedulers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to scale pandas/NumPy beyond memory or across clusters, parallelize file processing, or run distributed ML.

say_en.text: Use Dask to group this 50GB CSV by category and calculate the mean.
say_en.note: Builds a lazy task graph and computes the result.

say_en.note: Chunks are processed in parallel to limit memory use.

say_en.text: Clean multiple log files with Dask Bag, then convert to DataFrame.
